events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibes
angles.copy: Imagine you were there: three days of peace, love, and music that defined a generation. What's the one act you'd have loved to see at Woodstock '69?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember Elvis Presley, whose music and style changed the world forever. His legacy truly lives on.

events.title: Anniversary of Tupac Shakur's Death
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation and whose impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Anniversary of Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who redefined what was possible with a guitar. Still incredible.

events.title: The Beatles Release Abbey Road
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album Abbey Road in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Iconic
angles.copy: The Beatles' Abbey Road dropped on this day in '69, giving us that legendary zebra crossing photo and some timeless tracks. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, turns 75 today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Legend
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still delivering those Pretenders classics.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive voice of Oasis and a solo artist, turns 54 today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Liam
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon Released Imagine
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic album Imagine in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: On this day in 1971, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Released
events.blurb: Apple released the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? On this day in 2001, the first iPod arrived and changed our music world forever. What was your first iPod?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the enduring legacy of the iconic 007 film franchise.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Theme
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From Shirley Bassey to Billie Eilish, which 007 theme song gets your vote as the absolute best?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder John Lennon would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon – a musical visionary and a voice for peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles Release The White Album
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: On this day in '68, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album' – a sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your hidden gem from the tracklist?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the death of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched. The showman supreme.
